projectDesc.p: This transcription was made by the COMPAUL Project, funded between 2011-16 by a Starting Grant awarded to Dr H.A.G. Houghton under the European Union Seventh Framework Programme (FP7/2007-13 grant agreement 283302).

editorialDecl.p: This transcription was made on a Vulgate base text, initially from Scrivener's edition and then from online colour images at . This transcription includes all corrections, page layout information, formatting, punctuation, abbreviations, digraphs and rubrication. The initial transcribers were Christina Kreinecker and Rosalind MacLachlan in 2011; Rosalind MacLachlan adjusted the transcription in the light of the new digital images in October 2012 and it was then compared by Hugh Houghton in July 2013 with the proofread transcription from Scrivener: all differences were checked an resolved from the online images. Note that the abbreviation for aliq(..)d in 2:2 and 2:6 is the same as q(uo)d elsewhere, but the manuscript has aliquid plene in 2:6.
The proofread plain text file was converted to XML in October 2014. The original transcription guidelines can be found at
The XML specifications used are version 1.5 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at
